acceptance_criteria.criterion: A "Terminal session hygiene" subsection exists in the Monitoring Progress section
The subsection instructs the agent to launch full runs as background terminal processes
The subsection warns against running dry-run and full-run in the same foreground terminal session
The subsection reminds to reset cwd after cd + npm run build commands
node scripts/build-personas.js --check passes after the change

summary: Added a 'Terminal session hygiene' subsection at the end of the Monitoring Progress section in personas/standalone/src/content/orchestrator-runner.md. Three rules: (1) launch full runs as background processes (isBackground: true); (2) don't mix dry-run and full-run in the same foreground session; (3) reset cwd to $AI_INSIGHTS_ROOT after cd + npm run build commands. Both standalone persona targets rebuilt successfully.

comments.note: No observations — the terminal session hygiene subsection is clean and follows the same bullet-list pattern used elsewhere in the persona. The three rules are concise and actionable.
